item.text: [{"task_id":"d13f3404","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    scale = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    dr = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    dc = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))","    background = int(round(params['background'][0]))","    h, w = grid.shape","    if scale <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    oh, ow = h * scale, w * scale","    out = np.full((oh, ow), background)","    for r in range(h):","        for c in range(w):","            color = int(grid[r, c])","            if color != background:","                for k in range(oh + ow):","                    rr = r + k * dr","                    cc = c + k * dc","                    if 0 <= rr < oh and 0 <= cc < ow:","                        out[rr, cc] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"geometry":[3],"background":[1]},"params":{"geometry":[2,1,1],"background":[0]},"rationale":"Double both grid dimensions and extend every nonbackground input cell diagonally down and right, preserving its color until the output boundary."}]
